verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents user-created custom Unified Controls for controls it does not offer, which covers the custom-controls part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows custom frameworks, user-defined tests or monitors, or custom evidence requirements attached to those controls. Missing for 10: custom framework creation, custom automated tests/monitors for custom controls, configurable evidence requirements, details on how custom controls sit alongside built-in framework mappings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones

citations.quote: You can create custom Unified Controls to track and implement controls that aren't currently offered by Thoropass.
